0022600027.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (7-1) are first in the Atlantic and the East, riding a four-game winning streak with a 3-0 road record, as they visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-3), who are fifth in the East and two games back in the Central after a one-game losing streak. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), while Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle, sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring, soreness). The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 114-106 win in Philadelphia on October 22, and they lost all four meetings to Cleveland in 2025-26.
